The '''''Y'Tobba''''' was a ship owned by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] fringer [[Tobba]]. At one point, Tobba used the ship to store his [[Krayt dragon/Legends|krayt dragons]], which he had captured on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] in order to impress [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]].
